name: pyhouse-git
description: Repository workflow, independent of language and of any architecture. Ships the git-commit-message skill, which carries the Conventional Commits 1.0.0 convention an agent follows whenever it writes a commit message — a type that records the release the change earns, feat for a minor, fix for a patch, BREAKING CHANGE for a major, so a version is read off the history instead of argued at release time. Also the git-branching skill — one mainline, one merge method recorded per repository, short-lived branches whose history is cleaned before it lands and never rewritten after. Then /pyhouse-git:adopt, which records in a repository's agent instructions how its changes branch, land and are committed and turns off the agent's own authorship line, /commit, which reviews what is about to be staged and commits by that skill, and /install-commit-hook, which puts a commit-msg hook in the repository so a malformed message is refused at commit time, and /release, which proposes the next version from the commit types since the last tag and cuts it only on an explicit yes. And /release-notes, which drafts the release note for the project's users from the changes themselves, never from the commit subjects. Depends on nothing and is installed on its own.
